post.caption:
The Silk Road was a relay, not a highway. Almost no trader covered the whole distance; each worked one segment and handed the goods on, which is why prices multiplied at every transfer and why nobody could control the route. Silk, spices, paper, gunpowder, mathematics and religions all moved along it, mutating as they went because no one carried the full story. The Black Death used exactly the same routes.
